##### Project general facts

Azizi Plaza by Azizi Developments is a contemporary residential building that combines clean architecture with a practical approach to everyday community living. Panoramic windows and seamless balconies give the facade a light, modern character. The building rises from a ground floor to twelve residential floors and a roof, offering studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments designed with efficient layouts for professionals, couples and small families seeking a ready home in an established neighbourhood.

Residents enjoy a swimming pool and a fully equipped gym for an active daily routine, while shared lounge areas offer calm places to relax. Retail outlets, cafes and restaurants at ground level add everyday convenience, and lifts, secure parking and round-the-clock security provide comfort and peace of mind. Nearby parks, playgrounds, jogging tracks and community retail centres extend the range of leisure options available to residents and their families.

Interiors follow a bright, functional aesthetic that prioritises comfort and everyday practicality, with modern layouts, expansive windows and private balconies that enhance the living space. Contemporary finishes are chosen for durability and a clean look, giving owners a neutral canvas to personalise. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and appliances, leaving loose furniture to the owner's own taste and style.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Furjan is an established family-friendly community in western Dubai, known for its mix of villas, townhouses and low-rise apartment buildings in Arabic, Mediterranean and contemporary styles. Landscaped parks, playgrounds, sports courts, cycling and jogging tracks and community retail centres with cafes, supermarkets and clinics cover daily needs close to home and give the area a calm, green character.

Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Sheikh Zayed Road connect residents with the wider city, and the Al Furjan metro station is close by. Ibn Battuta Mall and the Jebel Ali Free Zone are a short drive away, Dubai Marina, Jumeirah Beach Residence, Palm Jumeirah and Expo City Dubai are close by, and the Dubai International Financial Centre, Business Bay and Al Maktoum International Airport are within comfortable reach.

Al Furjan is a freehold community open to international buyers and one of the most popular addresses in western Dubai. Metro access, mature infrastructure and proximity to Dubai Marina and the Jebel Ali Free Zone attract young professionals and families, supporting high occupancy. Ready homes at competitive prices in an established community underpin steady rental demand, attractive yields and long-term value for investors.
